mapper.select: select id, user_id, team_id, order_id, out_trade_no, goods_id, goods_name, credits, pay_price, status, paid_time, grant_time, create_time, update_time from credit_order where out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo}

select id, user_id, team_id, order_id, out_trade_no, goods_id, goods_name, credits, pay_price, status, paid_time, grant_time, create_time, update_time from credit_order where user_id = #{userId} order by id desc limit 100
mapper.insert: insert into credit_order( user_id, team_id, order_id, out_trade_no, goods_id, goods_name, credits, pay_price, status, paid_time, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{userId}, #{teamId}, #{orderId}, #{outTradeNo}, #{goodsId}, #{goodsName}, #{credits}, #{payPrice}, #{status}, #{paidTime}, now(), now() )
mapper.update: update credit_order set team_id = #{teamId}, order_id = coalesce(#{orderId}, order_id), status = #{status}, paid_time = coalesce(#{paidTime}, paid_time), update_time = now() where out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo} and user_id = #{userId} and status in ('WAIT_GROUP', 'GROUP_SUCCESS', 'GRANT_FAILED')
update credit_order set status = 'GROUP_SUCCESS', update_time = now() where out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo} and status in ('WAIT_GROUP', 'GRANT_FAILED')
update credit_order set team_id = #{teamId}, status = 'CREDIT_GRANTED', grant_time = #{grantTime}, update_time = now() where out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo} and status != 'CREDIT_GRANTED'
update credit_order set status = 'GRANT_FAILED', update_time = now() where out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo} and status != 'CREDIT_GRANTED'
